text:
You want to build several AI tools on top of existing AI services: an AI game, an AI decision-making tool, an AI bot for therapist/friend/coach use cases, and a custom market research tool for businesses.  

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience building Python-based ML and NLP tools. I can help design and package these products with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning workflows.  

A relevant project I built was Coffee review themes for Cobalt Coffee Roasters: a Streamlit app that grouped 38k reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week, reducing about 2 days a month of manual tagging. I also built an LLM evaluation harness for Quillstack: a regression suite that graded tutor-bot answers against a 400-item rubric, with judge-human agreement kappa 0.71 and 2 regressions caught before release.  

I’d be glad to help shape these tools into reliable, usable products.
